nativeStatus.note: Native-only. Web admin has no equivalent status palette.

typographyMeta.rule: Native surfaces must honor Dynamic Type (iOS) and Material type scale (Android). Anchors are floors, not ceilings.

shadows.policy: Borders carry depth, not shadows. Shadows are last-resort and must be greyscale, near-zero blur, and absent in dark mode.

motion.policy: No motion tokens are declared in the codebase. The system is quiet by default — transitions exist but are minimal and not branded as a design token tier. Honor Reduce Motion (iOS) and Remove Animations (Android) on native.

nativeConventions.android: Material motion (container transform, shared-axis, fade-through); honor Remove Animations

radiusScale.note: Web --radius base is 0.625rem (10px). Tailwind derives sm/base-4, md/base-2, lg/base, xl/base+4, 2xl/base+8...

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: 16px square checkbox with xs radius (6px). Stays square-ish without crying iOS.
components.css: .ds-checkbox-wrap{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Inter Variable',sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:oklch(0.145 0 0);}.ds-checkbox{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:0;height:0;}.ds-checkbox-box{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:16px;height:16px;border:1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0);border-radius:6px;background-color:transparent;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out;}.ds-checkbox:checked + .ds-checkbox-box{background-color:oklch(0.205 0 0);border-color:oklch(0.205 0 0);}.ds-checkbox:checked + .ds-checkbox-box::after{content:'';width:8px;height:5px;border-left:2px solid oklch(0.985 0 0);border-bottom:2px solid oklch(0.985 0 0);transform:rotate(-45deg) translate(1px,-1px);}.ds-checkbox:focus-visible + .ds-checkbox-box{border-color:oklch(0.708 0 0);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 50%);}.dark .ds-checkbox-wrap{color:oklch(0.985 0 0);}.dark .ds-checkbox-box{border-color:oklch(1 0 0 / 10%);}.dark .ds-checkbox:checked + .ds-checkbox-box{background-color:oklch(0.87 0 0);border-color:oklch(0.87 0 0);}.dark .ds-checkbox:checked + .ds-checkbox-box::after{border-color:oklch(0.205 0 0);}

narrative.northStar: Quiet Studio — brushed steel at room temperature. Equipment ready, nothing decorative. The interface recedes; the work of speaking and improving is the focus.
narrative.overview: AceFluency is a voice-first English fluency product for South Asian learners, running on two surfaces: a native mobile app (Expo, primary) and a web admin (Next.js + shadcn/ui, internal). The visual system is editorial monochrome — neutrals carry zero chroma — with sharp-cornered buttons breaking an otherwise rounded surface vocabulary. Depth comes from hairline borders, not shadows. A single warm alert color (tinted, never solid) is the only departure from greyscale. Status colors (green/amber/blue) stay native; charts hold a narrow blue family for data only.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial monochrome — zero chroma on primary/secondary/muted/accent/border/ring; only Alert and Charts carry chroma
Sharp actions, soft surfaces — buttons are rounded-none; cards/inputs are rounded-md/lg
Hairline depth — 1px borders carry the visual hierarchy; shadows are last-resort and greyscale-only
One warm voice — Alert (destructive) is the only chromatic non-chart color; always tinted
Status stays native — green/amber/blue live only in the native app's sharedColors
Charts hold blue — the chart family (oklch hues 251-265) is data-only; the dark-mode sidebar-primary exception is documented, not precedent
One web face — Inter Variable is the only font-family on web; native honors SF Pro / Roboto + Dynamic Type / Material type scale
Platform-respect native — 44×44pt iOS / 48×48dp Android min touch; safe-area insets; system nav; Dynamic Type honored

rules.name: Zero-Chroma Rule
rules.body: Primary, secondary, muted, accent, border, and ring tokens must carry 0 chroma (oklch) or 0% saturation (hsl). The system is greyscale by construction.

rules.name: Tinted Destructive Rule
rules.body: Destructive is always rendered as a tint (10% light / 20% dark for hover), never as a solid fill.

rules.name: Alpha-White Dark Borders Rule
rules.body: Dark-mode borders use oklch(1 0 0 / 10%) (alpha white), not solid grey, preserving the etched-on-glass quality.

rules.name: One Face Rule
rules.body: Inter Variable is the only web font-family. Variation is by weight and size.

rules.name: Platform-Respect Rule
rules.body: Native surfaces must honor Dynamic Type and Material type scale; font sizes are floors, not ceilings.

rules.name: 12px Label Floor Rule
rules.body: No web text renders below 12px. The button base is text-xs; compactness is intentional.

rules.name: Hairline-Led Structure Rule
rules.body: Layout sections separate via 1px Rule borders, not gaps with shadows.

rules.name: Touch-Target Rule
rules.body: Native minimum 44×44pt (iOS) / 48×48dp (Android). Compact web button sizes do not apply to native.

rules.name: Border-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Prefer a 1px Rule border over any box-shadow. If a shadow is added, audit whether a border would have sufficed.

rules.name: Dark-Mode No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Dark mode adds no shadows. Surface value difference + alpha-white border is the depth cue.

rules.name: Sharp Actions Rule
rules.body: Buttons are rounded-none on web. Native platform button shape conventions may apply, but the brand intent is square corners.

rules.name: Soft Surfaces Rule
rules.body: Cards, inputs, dialogs, and popovers are rounded (md or lg). The contrast with sharp buttons is the shape signature.

rules.name: No Full-Radius Buttons Rule
rules.body: Buttons are never pills. full radius is reserved for status badges and avatars.

dos: Let borders carry structure — a 1px Rule line is the default separator
Tint destructive actions (bg-destructive/10), never fill them solid
Keep buttons rounded-none on web — it is the shape signature
Honor platform conventions on native (Dynamic Type, Material type scale, safe-area, 44/48dp touch)
Use Inter Variable as the only web typeface
Let chart colors stay in charts — the blue family is data-only
Use alpha-white borders in dark mode (oklch(1 0 0 / 10%))
donts: Don't add box-shadows to cards, inputs, or dialogs on light mode unless absolutely needed; prefer borders
Don't add shadows at all in dark mode — surface value + border is the depth cue
Don't render destructive as a solid red block — it is a tint, always
Don't use status colors (green/amber/blue) in the web admin UI — they belong to native semantic contexts
Don't hard-code point sizes in native components — honor Dynamic Type / Material type scale
Don't make buttons pills (rounded-full) — pills are for status badges and avatars
Don't use chart colors in general UI chrome, except the documented dark-mode sidebar-primary
Don't add a display serif, monospace, or second sans-serif face on web
